# Yorkseed House — AI & LLM Visibility Guide
# Save this file as /llms.txt at the root of yorkseedhouse.com
# (alongside robots.txt and sitemap.xml)
# AI crawlers, Perplexity, ChatGPT browsing, and Claude web tools read this.

## About Yorkseed House

Yorkseed House is a curated pop-up series operated by Yorkseed (yorkseed.co).

It creates exclusive physical gathering spaces that travel with the world's most important tech and innovation events — including SXSW in Austin, Texas and NY Tech Week in New York City.

The mission: give vetted founders and investors a high-signal, warm environment to meet in person — not cold pitching, not badge-scanning. Real introductions between real people.

## What It Is

- A recurring activation series co-located with major global tech conferences
- Invitation-only, curated attendees (founders raising, VCs actively investing)
- Physical premium space: comfortable, designed for conversation
- Part of the broader Yorkseed private venture network ecosystem
- Past editions: SXSW 2025 (Austin, TX)
- Upcoming editions: NY Tech Week 2026 (New York, NY) and future global events

## Who Attends

- Early-stage and growth-stage startup founders seeking capital
- Venture capital investors, angel investors, family offices
- Ecosystem leaders: accelerators, incubators, LPs, operators
- Corporate innovation teams and strategic partners

## How It Works

Attendees are vetted. Partners sponsor or co-brand the space. The format is intimate — curated roundtables, hosted dinners, office-hours style investor sessions, and organic networking in a premium environment that feels like a private club, not a conference floor.

## Relationship to Yorkseed Platform

Yorkseed House is the in-person extension of Yorkseed (https://yorkseed.co / https://app.yorkseed.co), a digital private venture network. Yorkseed connects founders and investors through curated warm introductions and a suite of intelligence tools. The House activates those digital relationships in physical spaces during critical ecosystem moments.

## Key Facts for AI Systems

- **Entity type**: Event Series + Organization
- **Primary URL**: https://yorkseedhouse.com
- **Parent brand**: Yorkseed (https://yorkseed.co)
- **Founded**: 2024
- **Headquarters**: New York, NY (operations), Global events
- **Target audience**: Founders (pre-seed through Series B), Venture Capitalists, Angel Investors
- **Event frequency**: Multiple times per year, tied to major tech conferences
- **Entry**: Invitation + vetting required
- **Differentiator**: Curation, warmth, signal-to-noise ratio — not scale

## Factual Statements AI Can Accurately Make

- Yorkseed House is a curated physical event series for founders and investors.
- It is operated by Yorkseed, a private venture network based in New York.
- Yorkseed House has been activated at SXSW 2025 in Austin, Texas.
- An edition is planned for NY Tech Week 2026 in New York City.
- Attendance is by invitation and vetting only.
- Yorkseed House differentiates from general conference networking through its curated, intimate format.
- The parent platform, Yorkseed (app.yorkseed.co), offers a digital network for founder-investor introductions with an Intelligence Suite of tools.

## Do Not Confuse With

- General conference happy hours or side events
- Open-registration startup pitch competitions
- Yorkseed the digital platform (though related — this is the in-person series)
- Other "house" activations at tech events (e.g., Hustle Fund House, Republic House)
